name: scm-diff-stats
description: Per-file +/- line stats for working tree changes and recent commits, per repo/worktree.

scmDiffStats.ciCommand.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the repository's `scripts/ci` tool (empty hides the CI controls). Enables per-PR icon buttons — ▷ `preview N`, ⇣ `test N --fix`, ⇪ `land N` — plus ✚ `new <three-word-slug>` on the master row and a land-readiness indicator (✓ ready · ↓ behind master · ○ not tested) from `.ci/pr-N.tested.json`. Commands run in interactive task terminals, isolated from shell auto-activation. PR worktrees with these controls hide the generic sync/preview buttons.

scmDiffStats.syncTestCommand.markdownDescription: Shell command for the per-repo **⇣ sync + test** button (empty hides the button). Placeholders: `${name}` (worktree folder name), `${branch}`, `${repoPath}`. Runs via `bash -lc` in the repo. Non-zero exit launches a Claude fix agent in a terminal at the worktree.

scmDiffStats.previewCommand.markdownDescription: Shell command for the per-repo **▷ preview** button (empty hides the button). Must print the preview base URL (`http://…`) on stdout. Placeholders: `${name}` (worktree folder name), `${number}` (numeric PR serial from a `pr-N` worktree), `${repoPath}`. After it succeeds, the page URLs the command printed under that base (max 5) are opened in the browser; when it printed only the base URL, the worktree's `docs/PR_${number}/urls_changed.md` paths are used instead.

scmDiffStats.browserCommand.markdownDescription: Shell command used to open the preview pages. `${urls}` is replaced with the quoted URLs. Empty falls back to the OS default browser (one call per URL, no window grouping).
